subject: reasoning
question: Pravenesh starts from point A and drives 12 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Pravenesh starts from point A and drives 12 km towards the south.

He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 14 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d81384fcc567cf876bb9a672dcbdeb51a6ae53d78d2df662464c35924bd37cd.png] 

Thus, Pravenesh should drive 3 km (10 km - 7 km) in the west direction in order to reach point A again.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
